inspiration.observed_pattern: The MySQL dialect reference documents recursive subordinate traversal and INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE upsert semantics as reusable query patterns.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a hierarchy summary refresh. A recursive CTE counts descendants for each root and feeds an INSERT ... SELECT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE that refreshes existing summaries and inserts newly discovered roots; the reference examples, schema, names, and values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Root 10 starts with a stale summary and root 20 has no summary. The recursive source computes root 10's two descendants and root 20's one descendant; the upsert must update root 10 and insert root 20 without changing the hierarchy.
determinism_notes: Node IDs, parent links, target primary keys, recursive expansion, grouping, upsert assignments, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE refresh_nodes (node_id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT NULL, node_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE refresh_rollups (root_id INT PRIMARY KEY, descendant_count INT NOT NULL, max_depth INT NOT NULL, refresh_tag VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO refresh_nodes VALUES (10, NULL, 'north'), (11, 10, 'north-a'), (12, 10, 'north-b'), (13, 12, 'north-b-i'), (20, NULL, 'south'), (21, 20, 'south-a')

steps.sql: WITH RECURSIVE descendants (root_id, node_id, depth) AS (SELECT node_id AS root_id, node_id AS node_id, 0 AS depth FROM refresh_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT descendants.root_id, child.node_id, descendants.depth + 1 FROM descendants JOIN refresh_nodes AS child ON child.parent_id = descendants.node_id) SELECT root_id, COUNT(*) - 1 AS descendant_count, MAX(depth) AS max_depth FROM descendants GROUP BY root_id ORDER BY root_id

INSERT INTO refresh_rollups (root_id, descendant_count, max_depth, refresh_tag) WITH RECURSIVE descendants (root_id, node_id, depth) AS (SELECT node_id AS root_id, node_id AS node_id, 0 AS depth FROM refresh_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT descendants.root_id, child.node_id, descendants.depth + 1 FROM descendants JOIN refresh_nodes AS child ON child.parent_id = descendants.node_id) SELECT root_id, COUNT(*) - 1, MAX(depth), 'recomputed' FROM descendants GROUP BY root_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE descendant_count = VALUES(descendant_count), max_depth = VALUES(max_depth), refresh_tag = VALUES(refresh_tag)

checks.sql: SELECT root_id, descendant_count, max_depth, refresh_tag FROM refresh_rollups ORDER BY root_id
SELECT node_id, parent_id, node_label FROM refresh_nodes ORDER BY node_id
